approval_evidence.quote: NDA 204671 ... We have completed our review of this application, as amended. It is approved, effective on the date of this letter. (EDWARD M COX 12/06/2013)

launch_evidence.quote: Sovaldi ® (sofosbuvir 400 mg), which launched in December 2013.

series_start_reason: First quarter with Sovaldi sales: the fourth-quarter 2013 release (8-K Ex 99.1, 2014-02-04) prints a labelled Sovaldi line of 139,435 thousand USD, and the launch in December 2013 is stated in the second-quarter 2014 release.
series_end_reason: The first-quarter 2018 release (8-K Ex 99.1, 2018-05-01) prints no Sovaldi line. Sovaldi is counted inside the HCV product sales aggregate of that release (Epclusa, Harvoni, Vosevi and Sovaldi, $1,046 million). From the second-quarter 2018 release it sits in Other product sales, with footnote (3) reading 'Includes Cayston, Hepsera and Sovaldi'.
notes: Scope: worldwide brand total. 2013Q4 to 2014Q3 releases print a labelled Sovaldi line in thousands (converted to millions). From 2014Q4 the releases print Sovaldi U.S., Europe, Other International (Japan shown separately in 2016 releases) and an unlabelled total; the total is the sum of the printed regions in every quarter checked and includes Japan where Japan is printed. Four-quarter sums match the printed full years for 2014 (10,283), 2015 (5,276), 2016 (4,001) and 2017 (964).
search_log: Pulled data.sec.gov submissions for CIK 0000882095 and listed Item 2.02 8-Ks from 2013 to 2018; downloaded each earnings-release exhibit.
Sovaldi rows read from the 2013Q4 to 2017Q4 releases; the 2014 Q1 to Q3 releases use the labelled thousands line in the product sales summary.
Q1 2018 release searched for a Sovaldi row: none; the product appears only in the HCV aggregate.
Launch statement from the Q2 2014 release; FDA letter NDA 204671 (appletter/2013/204671Orig1s000ltr.pdf) read: signature 12/06/2013.
